evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers rs/q/a/a/a/o directly as ScriptPacket ID 38.
The handler reads selector 1, one base-37 encoded long username and one message String, decodes/normalizes the username through rs/O, then inserts the message through Client.a(message,6,username).
Exact v308 initializes rs/i/a.o to integer 6. The chat renderer's type-6 branch uses the surviving outgoing-private-message literals 'To <name>:' and 'To <name>'.
The same renderer applies private-chat visibility rules to type 6, while type 7 is the incoming private-chat event path; this independently fixes type 6 as the sent/outgoing private-message channel.

proposals.note: SentPrivateMessagePacketHandler is fixed by ScriptPacket 38 inserting chat type 6, whose exact renderer is the outgoing 'To <name>' private-message channel.
